capacity_limit: 18 remains a planning target. The measured installed aircraft is larger than each stowage spot; no claim of 18-aircraft physical fit.
equipment: Six static supplied models; placeholder deck tractor removed

cavitation.basis: Read built-in twin-lobe mesh positions and offset their midpoint to the Hyuga screw positions, 0.004 units aft of their axes.

preserved: R10.5 hatch repairs; accepted R16 island; CIWS scale and position; exterior hull; static radars
sources: Installed Sea Power resources.assets cavitation mesh
validation: Native fixed-edge and transform inspection; static placement preview; runtime wind pending
aircraft_fit_limit: Measured folded aircraft now fits the revised individual lift outlines offline. The 18 hangar stowage layout still does not fit those measured aircraft bounds and remains unverified.
deck_material: Original charcoal texture and markings; explicit low specular, low shininess, zero Fresnel. No raster edits.
hatch_fix: Backing panels moved inboard of native hatch skins; includes forwardmost port catwalk hatch at Z about 0.628.

flag.native_material_reference: flag_japan; native wind settings preserved, texture replaced with JMSDF ensign

wake: Stern foam footprint doubled to 0.70 and moved forward to -0.935 to overlap both waterline corners. Cavitation retained.
ventilation: Two side duct runs, 14 overhead louvred grilles and four wall return trunks. Lowest overhead blade at Y=.1334, beside the lift paths.
mashu_fittings: Maintenance dolly plus three extinguisher pairs
bow_adjustment: Raised gun parent, upper plinth and cap 0.0015 above R10.12 per user correction; scale unchanged
roof: Ceiling slab top extended to 0.15245; octagonal shaft reveals and roof corner infill added
decoy: Both outlets shifted 0.006 port and 0.0035 down; old openings restored and new bores cut
ride_adjustment: Both ride anchors moved 0.015 model units aft (about 1.5m) in response to in-game nose overhang screenshots. Height, lateral offset, spawn and taxi positions unchanged.
deck_uv: Unified top-surface planar mapping for deck and both moving lift tops; original images unchanged

r10_17.radars: Centered parent sensor pivots, scanner child offsets zero
r10_17.flag: MADFINGER wind materials, shared continuous UV mapping

aft_ciws: Rotating base initial yaw 180; support yaw 0; rest bearing 180
sonar: Sonar-MF stock audio clip; underwater only; detection definition unchanged
vls: 16 original hinged lids; 32 launch-triggered animations; 12 ESSM / 4 ASROC aligned containers

rigging.accuracy: Photo-informed arrangement adapted to current mast geometry; exact attachment dimensions not verified

finish.approach: Non-destructive shader tint and matte response; original raster textures retained unchanged. Only added hull pieces receive projected paint UVs.
finish.validation: Offline geometry, texture, configuration and rendered preview checks passed; in-game daylight test pending

torpedo_tubes.basis: Existing modeled tube end faces; native torpedo hatch/container configuration and MK32 timing. Cover hinge motion is a model-informed approximation, not a surveyed HOS-303 mechanism.
torpedo_tubes.validation: 17 sampled rays per tube at 324mm diameter, over 20 metres along the fixed launch axis with covers open; no hull intersections. Offline check only.

collars.accuracy: Photo-guided proportions; no measured real-world dimensions. Existing outlet centers and throat size retained.

funnels.accuracy: Photo-guided heights, rounded main outlets and thin rims; existing outlet centers/layout retained. Small auxiliary outlet details are model-derived.

crew.type: Static native standing crew; 1.8m height; no crew on flight deck, elevators or VLS.

rafts.station: starboard aft, between existing galleries above boat bay

safety_fittings.accuracy: Photo-guided shielded starboard aft row; 8 modeled canisters; row shortened to clear the existing stair landing, approximate size and spacing. Not a verified shipwide inventory. Existing rails/frames/openings retained. Netting uses original UV/alpha texture. No new deployment animation.

notes: CIC and fixed-array volume positions are model-based approximations, not a verified internal arrangement.
Existing hangar remains one logical flight-deck system, matching the native single Collider binding; no unsupported compartment keys added.
Armor, displacement, DC teams, engine volume, rudders, weapons, ranges and animations retained.
Generic damaged-state buckling is not hit-location-specific deformation; game impact effects remain responsible for local damage.
